__meta: REUSABLE. IVR request rate + failures (RED: Rate/Errors). Azure Monitor Logs over App Insights AppRequests. Bars for volume with a hidden 'Requests Total' reference series — the count-volume archetype from the reference dashboard's api-requests panels.
title: IVR — Request rate & failures
description: Requests and failed requests per minute for the IVR app, from App Insights AppRequests.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated $__timeFilter()
| summarize Requests = count(), Failures = countif(Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
